reason: I have never heard of RizqPure, and 'halal-certified' on its own means nothing to me until I know which body certified it and can check it myself. I'm not putting bovine collagen in my family's tea on a new brand's say-so.
objection: It doesn't name the certifying body. With collagen the whole question is the source, and reviews on their own website don't tell me the certificate is real or current.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the named certifying body (one I recognise, like HMC or HFA) with a certificate I can verify on the certifier's own website, plus a full source and abattoir breakdown.
